crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: This screen hit an error it could not recover from. Your data is safe on this device.
crash.guest: Error reports need an account, so nothing was sent.
crash.whatIsSent: A report says which error happened and where in our code. It never includes what you entered.

policy.body: It now covers error reports, which stay off unless you switch them on, and the Android check for updates on F-Droid.

common.wipeTestData: Wipe all local test data? This cannot be undone.

life.title: Life Patterns
life.buildingBaselineSub: Insights appear once you've got about 4 weeks of activity logged across the suite.
life.patternsEmpty: Nothing crosses the noise floor this week. Keep logging — strong patterns become more obvious over time.
life.footer: Insights derived from your logged activity — never causal claims.
life.weekTargetAdjusted: Adjusted for this week — your usual is {{baseline}}

auth.firstRunSubtitle: Finances, fitness, studies and habits — one score.
auth.firstRunPromise: No account needed. Start now, sync later.
auth.guestCaption: Local only — no cross-device sync. You can sign in later from Settings.
auth.passwordHint: Needs upper + lower case, a digit, and a symbol.
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to <1>{{email}}</1>. Click it to verify, then come back here and sign in.
auth.errPasswordShort: Password must be at least 10 characters.
auth.errPasswordWeak: Password needs upper + lower case, a digit, and a symbol.
auth.desktopBrowser: Finish signing in in your browser, then come back here.
auth.errDesktopNoListener: Desktop sign-in is unavailable this launch. Restart Nexus, or sign in with email below.
auth.errAlreadyRegistered: That email already has an account. Try signing in instead.
auth.errEmailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first — check your inbox for the link.
auth.errRateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
auth.errNetwork: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.ageNote: You must be 16+ to create an account (13+ where local law allows). Under that age, use guest mode — nothing leaves your device.
auth.otpHint: The code is valid for 60 minutes. The link in the email still works too.
auth.errOtp: That code did not work. Check it and try again.
auth.errOtpResend: Could not send a new code. Try again shortly.
auth.errOtpLength: That code looks incomplete. Copy the whole code from the email.

adoption.title: Existing data found
adoption.body: You have data stored locally on this device from before signing in. Should we adopt it into your account and sync it to the cloud, or discard it?
adoption.failed: Couldn't save your choice on this device. Try again.
adoption.footer: You won't be asked again on this account.
adoption.switchBody: This device holds another account's or a guest's data. Add its unsynced items to your account, or delete them here? Items already synced to the other account leave this device; they stay in its cloud. Signing out leaves everything as is.
adoption.switchFooter: Nothing here is shown or synced until you choose.
adoption.guestBody: This device holds data kept by an account that signed out. Keep its unsynced items as guest data, or delete them here? Items already synced to that account leave this device either way; they stay in its cloud.

onboarding.welcomeTitle: Let's set up your life OS
onboarding.welcomeBody: Nexus pulls your finances, fitness, studies, work and habits into one score — so you can see how your life is trending at a glance.
onboarding.profileBody: This sets which domains shape your Life Score. You can fine-tune the mix anytime in Settings.
onboarding.profileCustomHint: Prefer a custom mix? Set it later in Settings → Life Profile.
onboarding.domainsBody: These domains will feed your Life Score. Greyed-out ones are off in this profile.
onboarding.goalBody: Goals give your Life Score something to track against — a net-worth target, a workout count, a GPA. Optional; you can add them anytime.
onboarding.languageBody: You can change this anytime in Settings.

settings.errorReportsNote: When the app hits an error it cannot recover from, it sends us which error it was, where in our code, the app and Android or browser version, and the screen that was open. Never what you entered. Kept 90 days.
settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.guestBlurb: You're using NCC without an account. Local data stays on this device, but won't sync across devices and won't survive uninstall. Sign in to enable Supabase sync and cross-app SSO with LimeLog + StudyDesk.
settings.encryptionSub: Device-encrypted at rest (Android FBE) · TLS 1.3 in transit
settings.forceResyncConfirm: Re-queue ALL local data for upload to your cloud account? Useful if sync got stuck.
settings.aiFeaturesOnSub: On — your weekly scores are sent to Google Gemini to write the Life summary.
settings.aiFeaturesOffSub: Off — nothing is sent to Google. The Life summary is hidden.
settings.aiTrainingNote: Google runs this on their free tier, which means what you send may be used to train their future models. Leave it off if that is not for you.
settings.privacyPolicySub: What we store, and who else sees it
settings.lifeProfileBlurb: Which domains shape your Life Score and how they're weighted.
settings.notifPluginUnavail: Notifications plugin unavailable. Toggles still record your choice, but actual notifications need a working native build + OS-level permission to fire.
settings.notifMasterOffSub: All notifications off — turn on to enable categories below
settings.weeklyReviewSub: Sunday 18:00 · summary of finance, study, fitness, tasks
settings.taskRemindersSub: Heads-up when a task is due
settings.budgetAlertsSub: When a category nears or exceeds its monthly cap
settings.portfolioEodSub: Recap of today's move on US market close
settings.marketNewsSub: Stories about tickers you own + major market moves
settings.watchlistAlertsSub: When a watched ticker reaches a target price you set
settings.macroHeadlinesSub: Fed, CPI, jobs, FOMC, inflation, recession
settings.permMasterTail: If notifications already work at the OS level you can ignore this.
settings.permWeeklyTail: Toggle is on but reminder won’t fire until permission is granted.
settings.permToggleTail: Toggle is on but notifications may not fire until permission is granted in Android Settings.
settings.finnhubHelp: Get a free key at finnhub.io · 60 calls/min per key
settings.noFinnhubKey: No Finnhub key configured — US stock fundamentals, news and earnings will fall back to Yahoo. Add a key for richer data.
settings.twoSlots: Two slots round-robin per call — doubles your 60/min headroom.
settings.clearKeyConfirm: Remove this API key? You'll need to paste it again to use Finnhub.
settings.apiUsageResets: Resets at local midnight. Cached responses don't count against the budget.
settings.clearAllConfirm: Wipe ALL local data? This cannot be undone.
settings.pinReentry: Re-enter your 6-digit PIN to confirm wipe:
settings.wipeLocked: Too many wrong attempts — locked for {{n}}s. Wipe cancelled.
settings.pwResetSent: Password reset email sent. Check your inbox.
settings.changeEmailWhy: This changes the email you sign in with, in StudyDesk, NCC and LimeLog. We send a link to your current address and one to the new address, and the change takes effect once you have opened both.
settings.changeEmailPending: Waiting for confirmation: {{next}}. Open the links sent to {{current}} and to {{next}}. Until then, sign in with {{current}}.
settings.changeEmailTaken: Another account already uses that address.
settings.changeEmailRateLimit: Too many emails were sent just now. Try again later.
settings.changeEmailFailed: Couldn't send the links. Check your connection and try again.
settings.changeEmailInvalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
settings.changeEmailGoogle: You sign in with Google, so your email is your Google address.
settings.signOutBlurb: Choose what happens to data already saved on this device. Cloud data is untouched either way.
settings.keepLocalSub: Faster next sign-in. Choose this on your own phone.
settings.wipeLocalSub: Recommended on shared or borrowed devices.
settings.yourDataNote: Take a copy of everything, or erase it. One account covers Nexus Command Center, LimeLog and StudyDesk.
settings.deleteAccountNote: Erases your account and all its data, in all three apps, immediately and irreversibly. There is no recovery window.
settings.deleteAccountConfirm1: Delete your account and everything in it? This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteAccountConfirm2: Last check — this also erases your LimeLog and StudyDesk data. Continue?
settings.supportDevSub: Buy me a coffee on Ko-fi
settings.textSizeSub: Applies everywhere, including on your phone.
settings.textAutoSub: {{pct}}% on this screen size — larger on desktop, standard on a phone.
settings.feedbackBlurb: Tell the developer what's working and what isn't. Sent with your app version and platform so a report can be traced.
settings.feedbackPlaceholder: What happened, or what would you like to see?
settings.discordSub: Questions, bug reports, and what's coming next
settings.themeSupporterNote: Rack is a supporter theme. It unlocks when you support development on Ko-fi, below.
settings.fdroidCheckNote: Once a day, Nexus Command Center asks f-droid.org for its newest version. Nothing about you is sent. Turning this off stops the request entirely.
settings.signOutUnsynced_one: {{count}} change hasn't synced yet. “Keep local data” keeps it on this device and sends it the next time you sign in here; wiping deletes it. Until then, wiping this device's data also deletes unsynced changes.
settings.signOutUnsynced_other: {{count}} changes haven't synced yet. “Keep local data” keeps them on this device and sends them the next time you sign in here; wiping deletes them. Until then, wiping this device's data also deletes unsynced changes.

ins.techDesc: Composite Buy/Hold/Sell signals from RSI, SMA cross, price momentum, volume pressure, and headline sentiment. Heuristic — not investment advice. Refreshed once per calendar day.

wi.title: What If?
wi.assume1: Returns are nominal (before inflation). 7% nominal ≈ 4.5% real at 2.5% inflation.
wi.assume2: Markets don't return smoothly. A 7% average is wild year-to-year.
wi.assume3: Taxes and fund fees aren't modeled. Real-world outcomes are lower.
wi.assume4: Monthly contribution is constant — no raises or career changes.

recurring.depositHint: Moves the amount from the account into portfolio cash on each date.
recurring.marketHint: Uses the latest loaded price on each date. With no price loaded, the buy waits; it never guesses.

recurring.editHint: Changes apply from the next date on. Entries already added stay as they are.
